pairs.formula_description: Sum current-minute fill notional where fill notional >= empirical p99 of fills in prior 60 complete minutes, divided by all current-minute notional; eligible only if previous 60m has >=100 fills
pairs.event_time: exchange timestamp UTC of public trade fill
pairs.available_after: Only following completion of relevant window; actual source delivery not verified
pairs.missing_rule: empty events and absent archive must be marked separately; never infer missing as zero
pairs.independent_qc: May20 5/5 aggregate / distribution Decimal agreement only; see journal
pairs.caveat: Prior60 baseline yes; a fill is not a parent order; empty prior sample NO_DATA
